PSA 72:1.KJV: A Psalm for Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
PSA 72:1.BHSA: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃

PSA 72:2.KJV: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

PSA 72:3.KJV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
PSA 72:3.BHSA: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘לֹ֥ום לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָעֹ֗ות בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

PSA 72:4.KJV: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
PSA 72:4.BHSA: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט׀ עֲֽנִיֵּי־עָ֗ם יֹ֭ושִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְיֹ֑ון וִֽידַכֵּ֣א עֹושֵֽׁק׃

PSA 72:5.KJV: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
PSA 72:5.BHSA: יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דֹּ֣ור דֹּורִֽים׃

PSA 72:6.KJV: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
PSA 72:6.BHSA: יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 72:7.KJV: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
PSA 72:7.BHSA: יִֽפְרַח־בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝לֹ֗ום עַד־בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃

PSA 72:8.KJV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

PSA 72:9.KJV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
PSA 72:9.BHSA: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃

PSA 72:10.KJV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
PSA 72:10.BHSA: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃

PSA 72:11.KJV: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

PSA 72:12.KJV: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
PSA 72:12.BHSA: כִּֽי־יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְיֹ֣ון מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין־עֹזֵ֥ר לֹֽו׃

PSA 72:13.KJV: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
PSA 72:13.BHSA: יָ֭חֹס עַל־דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְיֹ֑ון וְנַפְשֹׁ֖ות אֶבְיֹונִ֣ים יֹושִֽׁיעַ׃

PSA 72:14.KJV: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
PSA 72:14.BHSA: מִתֹּ֣וךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃

PSA 72:15.KJV: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
PSA 72:15.BHSA: וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן־לֹו֮ מִזְּהַ֢ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדֹ֣ו תָמִ֑יד כָּל־הַ֝יֹּ֗ום יְבָרֲכֶֽנְהֽוּ׃

PSA 72:16.KJV: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
PSA 72:16.BHSA: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־בַּ֨ר׀ בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֢אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנֹ֣ון פִּרְיֹ֑ו וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 72:17.KJV: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
PSA 72:17.BHSA: יְהִ֤י שְׁמֹ֨ו לְֽעֹולָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ ינין שְׁ֫מֹ֥ו וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ בֹ֑ו כָּל־גֹּויִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃

PSA 72:18.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
PSA 72:18.BHSA: בָּר֤וּךְ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָאֹ֣ות לְבַדֹּֽו׃

PSA 72:19.KJV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
PSA 72:19.BHSA: וּבָר֤וּךְ׀ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבֹודֹ֗ו לְעֹ֫ולָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בֹודֹו אֶת־כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃

PSA 72:20.KJV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
